description:
Welcome to Citizen House Wolf Ranch in Georgetown, TX! 🏡 Join me for an exclusive tour of these beautiful 1 and 2-bedroom apartments that combine modern living with elegant design. From spacious floorplans to top-tier amenities like a resort-style pool, fitness center, and pet-friendly spaces, this community has everything you need for comfortable and stylish living. Citizen House Wolf Ranch is located just 35-40 minutes from the main gate of Fort Hood, making it an ideal location for military families. This community offers the perfect balance—close enough to base for convenience, yet far enough away to allow you to decompress and enjoy peaceful living after a long day.

If you're looking to rent or invest in Georgetown, TX, Citizen House Wolf Ranch is the perfect choice. Contact me, Darren Saint-Surin to learn more about finding your dream home in this incredible community. Schedule a consultation now: https://calendly.com/darrensaintsurin

📍 Property Highlights:
Spacious 1 & 2-bedroom layouts
Resort-style amenities, including a pool and fitness center
Pet-friendly community
Prime location near Wolf Ranch Town Center
